ferrier-aligo-mp5.label: Ferrier-Aligo / MP5
warnings: The strict column check is tools/ferrier_hires_wrf461_oracle/check_port.py. No forecast skill claim is made. Stock WRF's Rcw arithmetic order is retained.

REFLECTIVITY: WRF v4.6.1 computes Ferrier's DBZ_col and discards it, leaving REFL_10CM unwritten under mp=5.  gpuwm writes that column (clear air -20 dBZ) as REFL_10CM; its 10*ALOG10 is CUDA's log10f, so the diagnostic alone is outside the 0 ULP claim.
NEST AND OFFLINE CHILD: no cross-scheme nest edge is ported for mp=5 and the offline child refuses a Ferrier parent (no F_RIMEF_PHY wrfout row); same-scheme online nests run.

refused_when.reason: Eta Ferrier carries total ice in qs and phase fractions, with no separate qi or effective radii. The RTE cloud adapter has no total-ice partition for this package; treating it as a six-species scheme would lose its ice cloud. The Dudhia pair ra_lw_physics=0 / ra_sw_physics=1 is the other way out of this pairing.
refused_when.remedy_label: Set ra_rrtmg_variant='rrtmg_legacy', which computes its own radii the way WRF does.

new-sas.label: New SAS (YSU) with NSCV shallow convection
warnings: WRF 4.6.1 column conformance: all 1344 columns at 40 and 60 levels, including mixed-pressure rows, match deep, shallow and driver outputs at 0 ULP in both arithmetic arms. The oracle and one-bit mutation checks are in tests/test_nsas_column_oracle.py. This is implementation evidence; it does not establish observation-based forecast skill.
Deep cloud-search limits are reduced over the complete i-row as in module_cu_nsas.F:619-631. Workspace tiling does not split that reduction. Missing QC or QI tendencies follow WRF presence flags.
PRATEC is held between calls and RAINC grows by PRATEC*DT every model-clock step. Adaptive stepping requires cudt=0, as WRF requires of SAS schemes.
shcu_physics=4 is refused beside cu_physics=96 because NSAS already includes NSCV and the pairing would convect the same boundary layer twice.

wrf-cam3.label: WRF CAM3 longwave and shortwave
wrf-cam3.verification_scope_note: WRF v4.6.1 strict GPU replay of 96 columns captured during the 2000-01-24 12-15 UTC native forecast checks 145440 returned words: 142368 defined words are bitwise equal and 3072 cloud optical-depth words are a witnessed native-undefined residue in LW-only calls. Rust initialization matches 21962220 state bytes and 480 gas words. The complete fast-numerics woof go forecast has Rust maps at 13, 14 and 15 UTC beside native WRF and surface observations; exact real checkpoint continuation and GPU nest/member checks are recorded in docs/cam3-port-proof.json. At 4096 columns x 32 layers, refresh/reuse take 121.57/36.07 ms versus legacy RRTMG 11.95 ms. The 1.2x target is exceeded: native binary64 layer-pair absorption and aerosol work are retained; compiler frame and column-parallelism bottlenecks were fixed. This is a one-case comparison, not a general skill or whole-trajectory bitwise claim.
warnings: Plan and run door agreement is awaiting the release admission fix; do not treat the current composition as qualified.

Explicit selection only; never a default. Matched CAM/legacy-RRTMG whole forecasts cost 1.008509x in active wall time, 1.225603x in warm model-step time and 1.819315x in the radiation stage. Native maximum/random cloud-overlap shortwave work accounts for 57.9% of sampled inclusive CAM cycles. Fast column physics uses REAL32; this native work, not a binary64 port path, is the named opt-in cost. These profiles are attribution, not lower bounds.
